title: Notifications
items: Which mechanisms does the system use to notify you and IBM Support when significant events are detected?
SNMP traps, syslog messages, and Call Home emails
系統以 SNMP Trap、Syslog 與 Call Home Email 通知管理者與 IBM Support。
Up to how many syslog servers and SNMP servers can events be sent to?
Up to 6 syslog servers and up to 6 SNMP servers
系統 Event 可傳送到最多 6 台 Syslog Server 與最多 6 個 SNMP Server。
What is an alert in the event log?
Alert 需要採取行動；有 Error Code 者對應 Fix Procedure，沒有 Error Code 者代表非預期狀態變化，必須調查。
Which is an example of a message event?
Message 是預期中的狀態變化，例如 FlashCopy 作業完成。
Which error code has higher priority: 1020 or 1370?
1020, because lower error codes have higher priority
1370, because higher codes have higher priority
Priority is not related to code
Error Code 越小優先序越高，因此 1020 高於 1370。
How are notification types displayed in the event log?
Error and Warning as Alert; Information as Message
Error as Alert; Warning and Information as Message
通知類型 Error 與 Warning 顯示為 Alert，Information 顯示為 Message。
When are events generated during a recommended service action notified?
Only if they remain unfixed after the action completes
進行 Recommended Service Action 期間產生的 Event，只有在動作結束後仍未修復時才通知。
Do most CLI response messages generate notifications?
No, only events recorded in the event log generate notifications
只有記錄在 Event Log 的 Event 才會通知，多數 CLI 回應訊息不會產生通知。
Which command displays the event log?
Event Log 可在 Monitoring > Events 或以 `lseventlog` 檢視。
What does the Monitoring status in the event log mean?
The event does not yet require action
The event is an alert requiring a fix procedure
Monitoring 表示尚不需處理；Alert 依 Fix Procedure 處理後轉綠；Expired 表示已不再是問題。
What does the Event count field indicate?
The number of events merged into the log entry
The total events on the system
The number of alerts per hour
Event Log 容量有限，重複 Event 會合併，Event count 為合併數量，並保留第一次與最後一次時間。
What should you handle first according to the Root sequence number field?
The root event that might have caused this event
The event with the highest count
The event from the configuration node
Root sequence number 指出可能引發此 Event 的根本 Event，應先處理 Root Event。
Is the reporting node always the node where the object resides?
Reporting node 是回報該 Event 的 Node，不一定是 Object 所在的 Node。
Do all events have an error code?
Error Code 指出要執行的 Fix Procedure 或 Service Action，需要相同處理的 Event 共用同一 Code，但不是每個 Event 都有。
Which syslog facility values send messages in concise format?
Facility 0–3 的 Server 收到 Concise 格式，4–7 收到 Expanded 格式，預設為 0。
What is the default syslog facility value?
Syslog Facility 預設值為 0，Facility 也用來向接收端標示訊息來源。
In which format are audit and authentication syslog messages sent?
A single format; there is no concise or expanded distinction
Audit (-audit) 與 Authentication (-login) 訊息以單一格式傳送，沒有 Concise 與 Expanded 之分。
Which transmission protocols does the system support for syslog?
Syslog 支援 TCP、UDP 與 TLS。
What is the default port for syslog over TCP?
TCP 預設 Port 為 6514，UDP 為 514。
When using a domain name for a syslog server, what applies?
A DNS server must be configured and the name cannot exceed 40 characters
The name must be under 255 characters with no DNS
The name must match the system name
使用網域名稱時須設定 DNS Server，且名稱不超過 40 字元。
Which syslog option sends successful and failed authentication attempts?
Authentication log messages 會傳送成功與失敗的驗證嘗試；Audit log messages 則包含 CLI 與 GUI 操作。
How should warning notifications be treated?
Warning 表示問題或非預期狀況，應立即調查其影響並做必要修正。
What type of TLS authentication do the system and syslog server use?
Mutual TLS, where each side verifies the other's certificate
系統與 Syslog Server 使用 Mutual TLS，雙方互相驗證憑證。
Concept Guide Ch15 Syslog over TLS
Which tag must be turned on in the system trust store for the syslog server certificate?
Syslog Server 的憑證 (或其 CA) 必須安裝於開啟 syslog 標籤的 Trust Store。
How many CAs can sign the server certificates for syslog or SNMP servers?
系統只支援一個 CA 簽署所有 Server 憑證；若用自簽憑證，所有 Server 須使用同一憑證。
What should be included in the system certificate's subject alternative name for syslog servers?
The cluster FQDN and cluster IP address
系統憑證的 Subject Alternative Name 應包含叢集的 FQDN 與 IP Address。
Where are syslog notifications configured in the management GUI?
GUI 路徑為 Settings > Notifications > Syslog。
Which syslog protocol option is described as reducing system and network overhead?
UDP 用來降低系統與網路負擔，TCP 為可靠傳送，TLS 為加密傳送。
After creating a TLS syslog server in the GUI, how must you modify or remove its trust store entries?
GUI 建立 TLS Syslog Server 時會建立新的 Trust Store，既有 Server 的 Trust Store 項目需以 CLI 修改或移除。
Which command creates a syslog server?
`mksyslogserver` 建立、`chsyslogserver` 修改、`rmsyslogserver` 刪除、`lssyslogserver` 檢視。
Which SNMP versions does the system support?
系統支援 SNMP v2 與 v3。
Where can you download the SNMP MIB file?
MIB 檔可在 Settings > Notifications > SNMP 下載。
What is the default SNMP v2 community string?
SNMP v2 須指定 Community String，預設為 public。
Which SNMP v3 security model provides authentication and privacy at the message level?
USM 在訊息層級提供驗證與加密；TSM 則以 TLS 建立安全連線傳送。
Which credentials are required for the SNMP v3 USM security level Authentication and Privacy?
Engine ID, security name, authentication protocol and passphrase, privacy protocol and passphrase
Engine ID and security name only
Authentication and Privacy 需要 Engine ID、Security Name、驗證協定與密碼，以及 Privacy 協定與密碼。
Which SNMP v3 USM security level authenticates notifications but does not encrypt message content?
Authentication 層級會驗證通知但不加密訊息內容。
What is required for the SNMP v3 engine ID?
Use a unique engine ID for every system; the system does not generate it automatically
All systems share one engine ID
It is the system serial number
每個系統應使用唯一的 Engine ID，系統不會自動產生；首次設定須產生新的 Engine ID。
Does the system accept configuration GET requests from the SNMP server?
SNMP 不接受來自 SNMP Server 的任何 Configuration GET 請求。
When you send a test trap from the GUI, how do you know it succeeded?
Check on the SNMP server that the trap arrived; the system gives no success feedback
The GUI shows a green check
系統不會回報 Test 是否成功，需在 SNMP Server 端確認 Trap 已送達。
Which command sends a test trap to an existing SNMP server?
`testsnmpserver` 送出測試 Trap；`mksnmpserver`、`chsnmpserver`、`rmsnmpserver`、`lssnmpserver` 用於管理。
Which SNMP v3 security model is used for SNMP over TLS?
SNMP over TLS 使用 TSM，以 TLS 與 TCP 傳送 Trap。
Is DTLS (TLS over UDP) supported for SNMP?
系統不支援 DTLS (TLS over UDP)。
Why does SNMP over TLS improve trap delivery compared to USM?
TCP handles timeouts and retries, whereas USM sends traps over UDP with no confirmation
TCP 會處理逾時與重試，送達性優於使用 UDP 且無確認的 USM。
Which IP version is supported for SNMP over TLS?
SNMP over TLS 不支援 IPv6，系統與 SNMP Server 須使用 IPv4。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch15 Note
When might SNMP over TLS be preferable?
When your organization already has a public-key infrastructure
若組織已有 PKI，使用 SNMP over TLS 較合適。
Which tag must be turned on in the trust store for the SNMP server certificate?
SNMP Server 憑證須安裝於開啟 snmp 標籤的 Trust Store。
What happens to services that use certificate authentication when the system certificate changes?
They may be interrupted; add the new certificate to the necessary trust stores
系統憑證被所有憑證驗證服務共用，更換後相關服務可能中斷，需更新相關 Trust Store。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch15 Note
If an SNMP TLS test trap shows SSL or TLS errors in the server log, what should be checked?
That the correct certificates are installed and trusted on both sides and cipher suites are compatible
伺服器 Log 有 SSL/TLS 錯誤時，檢查雙方憑證是否正確安裝並信任，以及 Cipher Suite 是否相容。
Concept Guide Ch15 Testing the SNMP server
Which feature automatically notifies IBM Support of serious failures?
Call Home 讓嚴重故障自動通知 IBM Support。
Can SNMP traps, syslog, email, and Call Home be used at the same time?
No, only one method at a time
Only Call Home and email together
SNMP Trap、Syslog、Email 與 Call Home 可同時使用。
